intro: Defias brigands have taken over Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in southeastern Elwynn Forest. The farm once belonged to the Brackwell family, but now its cottage and fields serve as a hideout where conspirators meet and stolen mine gold is received.

p: You find the Brackwell farm southeast of the Stonefield homestead, its fields no longer tended. The Brackwell family has vanished, driven away or worse as crime spread through the area. The Defias Brotherhood now occupies the sturdy cottage and overgrown fields. Brigands regroup here beyond the reach of Goldshire's patrols. Morgan the Collector and other prominent conspirators use the isolated farm to receive illicit gold taken from the forest's mines.
